superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Ne bih Observerov prikaz parkinga pretvorio u dokaz dolaska automobila: promena sa 432 na 0 nema vremenske oznake merenja i ne može da utvrdi stvarnu popunjenost. Takođe ne mogu da upotrebim naslov o isključenjima struje da objasnim taj prikaz; mesto i vreme događaja ostaju neprovereni. [F12][F11][F22]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I would not turn Observer’s parking display into evidence of cars arriving: the change from 432 to 0 has no measurement timestamps and cannot establish actual occupancy [F12][F11]. I also cannot use the outage headline to explain that display; its event location and time remain unchecked [F22].
questions_sr: Da li prikaz parkinga odražava popunjenost ili grešku u izveštavanju? [F12][F11]
